trip.title: Baltimore → California
trip.subtitle: LA, the Pacific Coast Highway, redwoods & San Francisco
trip.notes: Open-jaw: fly into LAX, home from SFO. Carry-on only. Comfortable gas/hybrid crossover; not an EV.

days.label: Arrive
days.title: Land, grab the car, ease in

beats.text: Fly BWI → LAX. Pick up the rental at the airport, drive to the Mid-Wilshire / WeHo hotel (~30–45 min).
Easy neighborhood dinner — tacos at Sonoratown or a bowl at Kismet — and an early night to reset the clock.

days.fuel: First morning coffee: Go Get Em Tiger or Maru Coffee.

days.label: Los Angeles
days.title: The Getty by day, Griffith at dusk

beats.text: The Getty Center — tram up the hill, gardens, the collection, the view. Give it a solid half day.
Late lunch, reset at the hotel. Optionally LACMA or a wander down Melrose.
Griffith Observatory — arrive before sunset for city + Hollywood-sign views, stay for the lights.

days.fuel: Mid-day break: coffee + a bite at République (La Brea) or Alfred (Melrose Place).

days.label: Los Angeles
days.title: Universal Studios — the full day

beats.text: Rope-drop it. Studio Tour first, then headline rides before lines build.
Pace yourself; the park is up in the Valley (~25 min). Express Pass worth it if crowds are heavy.
Wind down at CityWalk or head back for a low-key dinner near the hotel.

days.fuel: Caffeinate before you go at Maru or Cafe Dulce — park coffee is mediocre.

days.label: Los Angeles
days.title: A beach walk and a proper eating day

beats.text: Drive to El Matador State Beach in Malibu — coves, sea stacks, a genuinely pretty walk.
Grand Central Market downtown — graze: tacos, egg sandwiches, Thai, pastries.
One nice LA dinner: Bestia (Arts District — book ahead), or splurge on the n/naka tasting menu.

days.fuel: Afternoon coffee: Gjusta or Great White in Venice; Verve on Melrose back in town. Food worth the detour: Langer's #19 pastrami (lunch), Guelaguetza, Howlin' Ray's.

days.label: LA → Cambria · ~5 hr + stops
days.title: Up the coast to Cambria

beats.text: Roll out early. First stop Santa Barbara — stretch, coffee, maybe brunch.
Push north through the Central Coast. Optional: Hearst Castle tour (pre-book) or wine detour near SLO.
Piedras Blancas elephant seal rookery — right off the highway, free. Then check into Cambria.
Sunset stroll on Moonstone Beach, dinner in the village, olallieberry pie at Linn's.

days.fuel: Handlebar Coffee or Helena Avenue Bakery in Santa Barbara; Cambria Coffee Roasting Co. on arrival.

days.label: Cambria → SF · ~6 hr + stops
days.title: Big Sur, the redwoods, into the city

beats.text: The showstopper stretch: Ragged Point, Bixby Creek Bridge, McWay Falls. Pull over often.
Nepenthe in Big Sur — cliffside terrace, famous view. Or Big Sur Bakery further on.
REDWOODS #1: Henry Cowell Redwoods loop near Santa Cruz — ancient coast redwoods, easy flat walk, on the route.
Into San Francisco, check into Nob Hill. Keep dinner simple — you've earned an easy one.

days.fuel: Café Kevah at Nepenthe for the view; Verve Coffee flagship in Santa Cruz for the last leg. If low on energy, skip the redwood stop — Muir Woods is lined up tomorrow.

days.label: San Francisco
days.title: The bridge and the big trees

beats.text: REDWOODS #2: Muir Woods, ~40 min north over the Golden Gate. Go early, reservation in hand.
Golden Gate Bridge vista on the way back — Battery Spencer on the Marin side for the classic shot.
Lands End coastal trail, or the Palace of Fine Arts + a wander through the Marina.
One nice SF dinner: Zuni Café (the roast chicken) or State Bird Provisions (book ahead).

days.fuel: Saint Frank on Russian Hill or Réveille. Old-school: an espresso at Caffe Trieste in North Beach.

days.label: San Francisco
days.title: Waterfront, the Rock, and eating around town

beats.text: Ferry Building Marketplace — oysters, Cowgirl cheese, coffee, the farmers' market if it's a market day.
Alcatraz (pre-booked) — the audio tour is gripping. About a half day with the ferry.
Fisherman's Wharf + Pier 39 sea lions, then North Beach and Chinatown. Cable car back up Nob Hill.
Casual and iconic: a Mission burrito at La Taqueria, or dim sum / North Beach Italian.

days.fuel: Don't-miss bites: Swan Oyster Depot (counter, lunch), Tartine for pastries, Golden Boy pizza in North Beach.

days.label: Depart
days.title: One last coffee, then home

beats.text: Final bakery run, or the Painted Ladies at Alamo Square. Drop the car at SFO.
Fly SFO → BWI. Carry-on only means a relaxed, no-baggage-claim exit.

days.fuel: Last coffee: Mr. Holmes Bakehouse or b. Patisserie before the airport.

reservations.name: Alcatraz ferry + tour
reservations.notes: Sells out weeks ahead — book first.

checklists.name: Book these early
items: Flights — open-jaw BWI→LAX / SFO→BWI, premium economy (2–3 mo out)
Alcatraz tickets (4–8 wk out — the true sellout)
Universal Studios dated tickets (+ Express Pass?)
Bestia (LA) + SF dinner (Zuni / State Bird); n/naka if splurging
Getty parking reservation; Hearst Castle tour if adding
Rental car — one-way LAX pickup, SFO drop

checklists.name: Packing (carry-on only)
items: Layers — SF mornings & Big Sur are cool/foggy
Phone car mount + charging cable for the drive
Downloaded Google Maps offline area for Big Sur
